text: 当前共有 30 个活跃事件。要点包括: Anthropic公司计划年底前建成5吉瓦算力; 长鑫存储据报在北京第二座晶圆厂规划3D NAND研发线; Sources: SK Hynix subsidiary Solidigm weighs building a NAND flash memory factory in the US; SK Hynix is also in talks with Intel for a separate project in Ohio (Reuters); Huawei details AI accelerator roadmap, pulls in next-generation Ascend NPUs by several quarters — FP4 performance of the Ascend 960PR doubles expectations; 罗福莉压力有多大？都给小米模型训练整上直播了。
